en: <CLT=cltMIND>The wall...next to the boiler...

<CLT=cltMIND>What could it be?
Perhaps it's just a prank...

How is your investigation going? Will you be
able to end the killing game your way?

Ah, it's going...fine...
I really just started...

There are a lot of areas in this
academy we haven't investigated.

Areas that you can't investigate...
Hmm...

...Rantaro's lab is also inaccessible, thanks
to Monokuma's ridiculous rule.

That's right, I'm concerned about that, too...
If only there were some way to get in—
I will help you.
Help me?

By destroying the door to his research lab
so you can enter it.
I-If you could...that would really help...

Then please head to his lab and I will meet
you there.
But be careful.

Monokuma will be after you for conducting
an investigation without his permission.

The Exisals may not kill you outright, but
they will definitely try to stop you.
Right...

If things get dangerous, call me and I will
deal with the Exisals.
You're going...to help me, Keebo?

I am not your enemy. That is why I am
helping you with your investigation.
But only until the time limit expires at dawn.
<CLT=cltMIND>Only until the time limit, huh...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose he's still hellbent on
destroying this academy.

Still...
You've changed, Keebo...

Is it because of this situation, or because
he can't hear his <CLT=cltSTRONG>inner voice<CLT=cltNORMAL>...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Right now...I should focus on Rantaro.

<CLT=cltMIND>He died before revealing his <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltMIND> talent,
but he seemed to know more than we did...

Hey, I have a question.
This might sound a little weird, but...

Does the term <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>
ring a bell for anyone?

<CLT=cltMIND>Before we even remembered that event,
he knew about the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltMIND>.
<CLT=cltMIND>But why?

<CLT=cltMIND>There might be a clue somewhere that
will lead us to the mastermind...

I'm going to do everything I can...
No giving up...

<CLT=cltMIND>I won't give up on <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltMIND>...
I need to keep <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltMIND> alive...

<CLT=cltMIND>And to do that...I need to
get inside Rantaro's lab.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Congratulations! You've unlocked the Keebo Gun!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Hold <PAD=【○】> or <PAD=【Ｒ１】> near an Exisal to
fill up energy.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When the energy is filled to the max,
Keebo will come to save you!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Use it as you need it!

<CLT=cltMIND>The wall next to the boiler...
I should investigate.

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo looks like he's taking a lot of damage...
Is he alright?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>The wall...next to the boiler...

<CLT=cltMIND>What could it be?
Perhaps it's just a prank...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's no time for investigating
the basement right now...
Around here...?
<CLT=cltMIND>This area used to be covered in grass.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it's been completely removed...
It shouldn't be hard to find it now.

<CLT=cltMIND>I let out a gasp when
I saw <CLT=cltSTRONG>it<CLT=cltMIND>.
"twins b"?
Is this the second message?
<CLT=cltMIND>What could this possibly mean?

<CLT=cltMIND>If it was written by Kokichi,
like the other message...
<CLT=cltMIND>Are they meant to be read together?

In that case...it seems as though
the message is incomplete...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Two Mysterious Messages<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>But if this is incomplete, what was
Kokichi trying to do by telling us—
Wh-!? A-Again!?
Shuichi Saihara...

Do you have your <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL>
memory back?
...Yes.

As the Headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy,
I want to ask you...
...to please cooperate with the Gofer Project.
I do feel bad about this...

I know how much you all wanted to run, 
even if it meant no longer being <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=typeNORMAL>...

Those of you who have to live on like this
might be the real victims here...

But the only people who can go through with this
project are you 16 who haven't been infected...

The fate of humanity...rests on 
your shoulders.
The fate...of humanity?
...What's the point?
Huh?

Even if this ridiculous mission is a success,
and we all survive...
...what's the point?
Why try so hard to save the seeds of humanity?
...I don't understand.

Perhaps...you'll be the ones who will
create that point.
...Huh?

It's true that this situation you're all 
being forced into is harsh.

So harsh...that you think it'd be better 
to just die.
But I still want you all to live.

For those of us who want to live, but can't...
you 16 who *can* live are...
...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> itself.

So please... I don't want to see you 
give up <CLT=cltSTRONG>"hope"<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
I want you to keep <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> alive...
Ah...my head...
<CLT=cltMIND>I...remembered something again...

We were at Hope's Peak...
And we participated in the Gofer Project—

<CLT=cltMIND>At that moment, I heard something
crumbling above me...
*pant, pant* Ugh... Ah...
Shuichi, what's wrong? Are you alright?
K-Keebo...
Yeah...I'm...okay...

I'm sorry... I experienced a sudden flashback
and my hands slipped...
Ah, did you remember, too, Keebo?

Yes. We were at Hope's Peak Academy, about
to sign on for the Gofer Project.

...What is Monokuma thinking,
having us remember that *now*...?

He's probably trying to make us feel
<CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> again.
<CLT=cltMIND>Despair?
<CLT=cltMIND>No, but...these memories...

"twins b"...? Shuichi, what do you make
of this message?

I found a will in Kokichi's room...
one that mentioned a "second message."
So I went to look for it.
...So Kokichi entrusted us with his will.
And a second message as well...

Could this message he left be related to
that message he wrote on the ground?

Do you think he tried to add to that
message...in order to tell us something?

I don't know, the will 
didn't say...

<CLT=cltMIND>If he was going to add more,
the message was incomplete.

<CLT=cltMIND>But if this is incomplete, what was
Kokichi trying to do by telling us?
"twins b"...

<CLT=cltMIND>If it was written by Kokichi,
like the other message...
<CLT=cltMIND>Are they meant to be read together?

In that case...it seems as though
the message is incomplete...

<CLT=cltMIND>But if this is incomplete, what was
Kokichi trying to do by telling us?

<CLT=cltMIND>The wall next to the boiler...
I should investigate.

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo looks like he's taking a lot of damage...
Is he alright?

<CLT=cltMIND>The wall next to the boiler...
I should investigate.

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo looks like he's taking a lot of damage...
Is he alright?
<CLT=cltMIND>It says "This world is mine. Kokichi Oma."
That message Kokichi wrote...

It's something he fabricated to trick us into
thinking he was the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
That's true, but...
<CLT=cltMIND>Was that...really his intention?
<CLT=cltMIND>It says "This world is mine. Kokichi Oma."

<CLT=cltMIND>When Gonta first found it,
it was an incomplete jumble of letters.
<CLT=cltMIND>Eventually, it had more added to it...
<CLT=cltMIND>And in the end...
<CLT=cltMIND>It made the message, "This world is mine. Kokichi Oma."

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi wrote that in an attempt to make
us believe he was the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>Was that...really his intention?
